lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr4Mg(AlGe)4 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 123), with 13 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Ge each adopt tetrahedral coordination with four neighbors, while Mg is surrounded by 16 neighbors and Sr by 20; the neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Al and Ge tetrahedra, edge-sharing between Al tetrahedra and Sr 20-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Ge tetrahedra and Mg 16-vertex polyhedra.
